topic: The safety and efficacy of mRNA vaccine technology
motion: Rapid development timelines and limited long-term data make mRNA vaccines fundamentally untrustworthy compared to traditional vaccine methods.

CA.what_changes_mind: Independent audits of VAERS with dedicated funding and staffing, coupled with transparent reporting of all adverse event data, regardless of perceived causality.

SA.what_changes_mind: Concrete evidence showing a direct link between post-vaccination health issues and a coordinated effort to suppress information related to vaccine safety.

debate_log.claim: Rapid development timelines and limited long-term data make mRNA vaccines fundamentally untrustworthy compared to traditional vaccine methods.
